# Quarterly Report

This report covers the results of the third quarter. Revenue grew in every region, and the team shipped two new products. The details are in the sections below.

## Highlights

- Revenue grew by twelve percent
- Two products shipped on time, with a long description that wraps onto the next line of the item
- Costs stayed flat

### Next steps

1. Hire two engineers
2. Open the Berlin office

The plan is **ambitious** but *realistic*, and the budget for it was approved by the board in the last meeting of the quarter, which means the work can start right away and the first results should be visible before the end of the year. Progress is reviewed every month.

## Risks

Hiring could take longer than planned. Prices for cloud services may rise.
